description.en: Run a multi-lens investment committee workflow that compares quality, value, growth, sentiment, technical, macro, and risk evidence through QVeris.
description.zh: 通过 QVeris 运行多视角投资委员会流程，对比质量、价值、成长、情绪、技术、宏观和风险证据。

overview.en: Use this skill when a user wants a debate-style investment memo instead of a one-shot stock summary. The agent assigns lenses, calls QVeris evidence for each lens, scores disagreements, and produces a decision-ready committee note.
overview.zh: 当用户需要辩论式投资 memo，而不是一次性股票摘要时使用。Agent 会分配不同分析视角，为每个视角调用 QVeris 证据，评分分歧并生成可供决策的委员会纪要。

description.en: Run a buy/hold/sell debate with multiple evidence lenses.
description.zh: 用多个证据视角做买入/持有/卖出辩论。

prompt.en: Use QVeris to run an investment committee debate for AAPL. Include quality, value, growth, sentiment, technical, macro, and risk lenses. Each lens must cite the QVeris capabilities called, then produce a final buy/hold/sell view with dissenting evidence.
prompt.zh: 用 QVeris 为 AAPL 运行投资委员会辩论。包含质量、价值、成长、情绪、技术、宏观和风险视角。每个视角说明调用的 QVeris 能力，最后给出买入/持有/卖出观点和反对证据。

description.en: Compare two candidates and expose where analysts disagree.
description.zh: 比较两个候选标的并暴露分歧。

prompt.en: Use QVeris to compare MSFT and GOOGL as committee candidates. Assign bull and bear views, call the evidence needed for each, and end with a ranked decision and open questions.
prompt.zh: 用 QVeris 比较 MSFT 和 GOOGL。分配多头和空头视角，为每个视角调用必要证据，最后给出排序决策和待确认问题。

description.en: Let risk evidence overrule the investment case when needed.
description.zh: 在必要时让风险证据推翻投资观点。

prompt.en: Use QVeris to test whether TSLA has a risk veto today. Call market data, recent news, fundamentals, filings, and sentiment, then decide whether risk overrides the thesis.
prompt.zh: 用 QVeris 测试 TSLA 今天是否存在风险否决项。调用行情、近期新闻、基本面、公告和情绪数据，然后判断风险是否推翻 thesis。

description.en: Turn structured financial data into callable agent capabilities.
description.zh: 把结构化金融数据变成 Agent 可调用能力。

description.en: Add market data coverage for global research and screening workflows.
description.zh: 为全球研究和筛选工作流补充市场数据覆盖。

description.en: A practical workflow for source-backed A-share monitoring.
description.zh: 面向 A 股监控和来源证据研究的实用工作流。

purpose.en: Find finance, news, filings, sentiment, technical, macro, and risk capabilities for each debate lens.
purpose.zh: 为每个辩论视角寻找财务、新闻、公告、情绪、技术、宏观和风险能力。

qveris_api.sample_query: stock fundamentals news sentiment technical indicators macro risk API

purpose.en: Confirm every committee lens has adequate coverage and visible billing before execution.
purpose.zh: 执行前确认每个委员会视角都有足够覆盖和清晰计费。

purpose.en: Call selected capabilities, attach evidence to each lens, and produce a traceable committee memo.
purpose.zh: 调用选定能力，把证据挂到每个视角，并生成可追踪的委员会 memo。

summary.en: This workflow usually needs 10-30 paid Calls after free Discover and Inspect preflight. Cost depends on providers, ticker count, and time window.
summary.zh: 该工作流通常在免费 Discover 和 Inspect 预检后需要 10-30 次付费 Call。费用取决于供应商、股票数量和时间窗口。

note.en: Ask for explicit approval before paid Calls. Inspect billing_rule for every selected capability and reduce scope if the estimate is too high.
note.zh: 付费 Call 前必须获得明确确认。检查每个选定能力的 billing_rule；如果预计成本过高，先缩小范围。

description.en: Define the committee lenses and what evidence would change each view.
description.zh: 定义委员会视角，以及什么证据会改变每个观点。

description.en: Use QVeris to find data capabilities for each lens and inspect costs before calls.
description.zh: 用 QVeris 为每个视角寻找数据能力，并在调用前检查成本。

description.en: Call evidence, score confidence, and record disagreement between lenses.
description.zh: 调用证据、评分信心，并记录视角之间的分歧。

description.en: Return final view, dissenting evidence, risk vetoes, and usage trace.
description.zh: 返回最终观点、反对证据、风险否决项和使用记录。
